# personal-claude.md-updates

> Version-controlled home for the global Claude Code / Cowork instruction files:
> the CLAUDE.md loaded at the start of every session, plus the canonical
> CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md standards that agents auto-deploy into any
> repo that is missing them.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): canonical agent guide — compact repository behavior rules, README trigger table, Contents API mechanics.
- [README.md](README.md): human quickstart — setup, symlinking, and how auto-deployment works.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): full commit-message format, 9-section README template, and pre-push checklist.

## Configuration
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): global session instruction file — routing rules for dispatch, capture triggers, memory writes, and GitHub repo tasks.

## Key rules
- CLAUDE.md here mirrors the live global instructions; edit the live copy, then push the update with a full commit body.
- CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md are the canonical templates — agents push them into any repo that lacks them before doing other work.
- Every feat/fix commit needs a multi-bullet body; one-liner commit messages are not acceptable.
- README.md must be kept current (all 9 sections) on every feat, fix, or data commit.
- No tokens or secrets are ever committed; API pushes use a locally stored token with repo scope.
